snippet.title: Inky Blinky Bob is Coming Soon On Steam!
snippet.description:
Play free demo at:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4305130/Inky_Blinky_Bob

Wishlist now on Steam, coming March 20th.

Pilot a weaponized hot air balloon across a chain of dangerous islands overrun by failed experiments. Scavenge resources, upgrade your flying machine, and dismantle the defenses of an occult biotech corporation before its greatest creation breaks free.
